    idle = (0x3F800000, 0x3F800000, 0, 0)
    drive_vectors = vectors + [idle, idle, idle]

    for cycle, (a_bits, b_bits, op, mode) in enumerate(drive_vectors):
        await bounded(FallingEdge(dut.clk))
        dut.opa.value = a_bits
        dut.opb.value = b_bits
        dut.fpu_op.value = op
        dut.rmode.value = mode

        await bounded(RisingEdge(dut.clk))
        await Timer(1, unit="ns")

        result_index = cycle - 3
        if result_index < 0 or result_index >= len(vectors):
            continue

        want = expected[result_index]
        if want is None:
            continue

        got = {name: int(getattr(dut, name).value) for name in OUTPUTS}
        for name in OUTPUTS:
            if want[name] is not None:
                assert got[name] == want[name], (
                    f"cycle {result_index}, op={vectors[result_index][2]}, "
                    f"mode={vectors[result_index][3]}, "
                    f"opa=0x{vectors[result_index][0]:08X}, "
                    f"opb=0x{vectors[result_index][1]:08X}: "
                    f"{name} got 0x{got[name]:X}, expected 0x{want[name]:X}"
                )
